summary: P5 grind pass (2026-08-04): re-measured every item against the CURRENT tree — the mode popover and a two-pane provider/model picker had already landed since this map was written, ahead of this pass. Fixed in this pass: kit ContextMenu's separator primitive (both danger-item menus now carry the prototype's hairline), the active-item check icon's color (kit-wide, was the orange accent, now teal), the workspace menu's pin label (now toggles pin/unpin workspace like the session menu, with no check-icon column), and 'remove workspace' now goes through a confirmation modal instead of firing the DELETE straight from the click. The provider/model picker gained status-colored provider rows, a wired 'provider settings' gear, and honestly-flagged (visible, disabled, red) per-model settings gears — real grammar it lacked (a per-provider multi-config sub-picker, a live sampling-parameter editor) has no backend surface and is left unbuilt rather than faked; see wire gaps. Also fixed a kit-wide popover bug found while measuring: the composer's up-placement popovers inherit `max-height:320px; overflow-y:auto` from the shared kit-popover, but the provider/model picker's own CSS was overriding it to `overflow:hidden`, silently discarding any provider past the visible fold with no way to reach it. One deliberate, documented non-fix: the rail's 'agents' footer cell opens a live multi-backend switcher instead of the prototype's plain Settings navigation — a real axis (multiple connected clio deployments) the prototype's single-backend demo never modelled; Settings > Agents still serves the nav-equivalent path.

items.element: Provider/model picker popover (composer footer model selector)
items.proto_truth: Two-column widget, ~480px wide, resizable both dimensions. Header: eyebrow 'providers' + gear icon ('Provider settings'). Left column: one row per provider (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Codex, Claude Code, ALCF Sophia, ALCF Metis, vLLM) each showing name + a 'default ⌄' per-provider config picker + a color-coded status label (ready / no key / signed out / offline). Right column: models of the selected provider, each with a gear icon opening a per-model sampling-parameter editor ('saved per model on this provider'), active model shown in teal name-color + teal check. Footer row: eyebrow 'thinking' + effort chips (default/off/low/medium/high). Captured live: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/proto-router-menu.png (source: design/prototype/Clio Session.html popRouter block).
items.backend_surface: PATCH /v1/sessions/{id} body.model={provider_id, model_id, variant} (per-session pick, real); GET/PUT /v1/providers/lm (global daemon LM config + presets, real); no endpoint for a per-model sampling-parameter store
items.fix_hint: Landed this pass: eyebrow+gear header (gear wired to onOpenProviderSettings -> Settings), per-provider status label color-coded by tone (ok/warn/error via a real statusTone(status) mapping over LmPreset.status vocabulary), the extraneous 'models' eyebrow removed (prototype has none over the right pane), the non-selected models' stray tool-icon removed (prototype shows no icon there), and a real (always-visible, disabled, red) per-model settings gear matching the prototype's own always-visible gear geometry — flagged rather than functional, since no sampling-param wire exists. STILL missing, and left unbuilt rather than faked: the per-provider 'default ⌄' config sub-picker. The DATA exists (GET /v1/providers/lm's presets[] can have >1 entry per provider — e.g. argonne_metis + argonne_sophia both provider:'argonne', confirmed live) but the only mutation path (PUT /v1/providers/lm) changes the GLOBAL daemon LM config, not a per-session pick — wiring a per-provider switcher into a per-session composer popover would have every session's composer silently reconfigure every OTHER session's model. That is a real product/architecture call (which scope owns the mutation) outside a menu-grammar polish pass; flagging rather than guessing. The sampling-parameter editor content itself (gear -> a 'sampling · {model}' back-panel with numeric override rows) has zero wire surface at all — PATCH's `variant` field is never populated from a real store — and is correctly left as the visible-degraded marker only.

items.element: kit Popover (up placement) — provider/model picker silently killed the inherited scroll
items.proto_truth: N/A (a kit-bug finding surfaced by the live provider catalogue outgrowing the prototype's fixed placeholder set, not a prototype-vs-source comparison).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/popover.css:.kit-popover[data-placement='up'] sets `max-height:320px; overflow-y:auto`; apps/web/src/composer/provider-model-picker.css was overriding it with `overflow:hidden`, so any provider past the visible fold (the live backend surfaces up to 10) was simply unreachable — not scrollable, not visible, no error. Fixed to `overflow-x:hidden` only, restoring the inherited vertical scroll. Verified visually: apps/web/screenshots/side-by-side/menus-grammar-model.png (header stays anchored, list is reachable by scroll).
